summary: This resolution sets procedures for House floor consideration of H.R. 5625, H.R. 6260, H.R. 8365, H. Con. Res. 96, and H.R. 8469 by waiving points of order, adopting Judiciary Committee substitutes, limiting debate to one hour per measure, and allowing one motion to recommit on each bill.

scores.thoughts: This is a purely procedural resolution establishing debate rules for several bills. It contains no provisions that authorize, appropriate, or alter any government spending levels.
The resolution is procedural and makes no reference to tax policy, rates, or revenue measures.
No provisions in the resolution address healthcare policy, coverage, or regulation.
The resolution does not engage with firearms regulation or Second Amendment issues.
No immigration-related content appears in the resolution.
The resolution contains no language concerning reproductive rights or abortion access.

While the resolution sets procedures for considering an appropriations bill that includes military construction funding, the resolution itself is strictly procedural and does not alter defense spending levels or policy.
No environmental or climate provisions are present.
The resolution does not address welfare programs or social safety net policies.
No education policy content exists in the resolution.
The resolution makes no reference to drug enforcement or decriminalization.
The resolution is procedural and does not itself enact or modify criminal justice policy, even though it facilitates consideration of related bills.
No trade or tariff provisions are included.
The resolution does not address deficits, debt ceilings, or fiscal policy.
No provisions relate to LGBTQ+ legal protections.
The resolution contains no foreign aid provisions.
